summary: This is a routine earnings press release on Form 6-K filed by Trip.com Group Ltd reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed.
